findings.desc: In P301S tau transgenic mice on human ApoE knock-in or ApoE knockout backgrounds, ApoE4 mice (TE4) had significantly higher brain tau levels than TE2, TE3 and TEKO mice at 3 months of age (RAB fraction), and at 9 months the elevated tau had shifted into the less soluble RIPA fraction, indicating more insoluble tau accumulation.
findings.exp_system: P301S human tau transgenic mice crossed with human APOE2/APOE3/APOE4 knock-in or ApoE knockout mice (TE mice); quantitative ELISA of sequentially extracted (RAB, RIPA, formic acid) brain tau
findings.quote: At 3 months of age, prior to overt tau pathology onset, TE4 mice had significantly higher tau levels in the RAB fraction than other ApoE genotypes (Fig. 2a).
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (higher brain tau levels, shifting into less soluble fractions)

findings.desc: At 9 months of age, P301S/E4 mice developed significantly more brain atrophy (hippocampal, piriform/entorhinal cortical and amygdala volume loss with ventricular enlargement, and thinning of the dentate gyrus granule cell and CA1 pyramidal layers) than P301S/E2 and P301S/E3 mice, whereas ApoE knockout largely attenuated neuronal loss and atrophy.
findings.exp_system: P301S human tau transgenic mice on human APOE knock-in or ApoE knockout backgrounds; brain volumetry and neuronal layer thickness at 9 months
findings.quote: We observed significantly more brain atrophy in 9-month old P301S/E4 (TE4) mice compared to P301S/E2 (TE2) and P301S/E3 (TE3) mice (Fig. 1a, b)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more tau-mediated brain atrophy and neuronal loss)

findings.desc: P301S tau-expressing neurons co-cultured with ApoE4-expressing mixed glia secreted a significantly higher level of TNF-alpha and showed markedly reduced neuronal viability compared with neuron/E2 and neuron/E3 co-cultures; neurons co-cultured with ApoE-knockout glia showed the greatest viability with the lowest secreted TNF-alpha.
findings.exp_system: Primary P301S tau-expressing neurons co-cultured with mixed glia derived from human ApoE knock-in or ApoE knockout mice; TNF-alpha ELISA and neuronal viability assay
findings.quote: In addition, a significantly higher level of TNFα was detected in the neuron/E4 co-culture medium whereas minimal TNFα levels were detected in the neuron/EKO co-culture medium (Fig. 4h)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4 in glia) -> (more TNF-alpha secretion and reduced viability of tau-expressing neurons)

findings.desc: Tamoxifen-induced removal of astrocytic APOE4, begun at 5.5 months after tau pathology onset, significantly reduced insoluble phosphorylated tau in cortical extracts of female P301S Tau mice and reduced AT8-positive tau deposition in the hippocampus of female TAFE4 mice; astrocytic APOE3 removal had minimal effect on pTau pathology.
findings.exp_system: P301S Tau transgenic mice with astrocyte-specific tamoxifen-inducible APOE3 or APOE4 deletion (Aldh1l1-CreERT2; floxed APOE), treated at 5.5 months and assessed at 9.5 months; cortical pTau ELISA and hippocampal AT8 immunostaining
findings.quote: TAM treatment reduced AT8 immunoreactivity in female TAFE4, but not in male TAFE4 or in TAFE3 mice.
findings.summary: (astrocytic APOE4 removed) -> (less insoluble phosphorylated tau and AT8 tau deposition)

findings.desc: Decreasing astrocytic APOE4 expression at 5.5 months significantly attenuated tau-mediated hippocampal and entorhinal/piriform cortical volume loss in both male and female TAFE4 mice, but not in TAFE3 mice, and significantly reduced plasma neurofilament light chain, a marker of neuro-axonal damage.
findings.exp_system: P301S Tau transgenic mice with astrocyte-specific tamoxifen-inducible APOE3 or APOE4 deletion, treated at 5.5 months and assessed at 9.5 months; brain volumetric analysis and plasma NFL
findings.quote: TAM-treatment significantly attenuated brain atrophy in both male and female TAFE4 mice, but not in TAFE3 mice (Figure 2A–2C).
findings.summary: (astrocytic APOE4 removed) -> (less tau-mediated brain atrophy)

findings.desc: Removal of astrocytic APOE4 decreased tau-induced synaptic loss and microglial phagocytosis of synaptic elements: PSD-95 puncta coverage in entorhinal/piriform cortex was increased in TAFE4 mice after astrocytic APOE4 knockdown. Class 3 because the readout is synaptic density, a downstream consequence of tau pathology, rather than tau itself.
findings.exp_system: P301S Tau transgenic mice with astrocyte-specific tamoxifen-inducible APOE4 deletion; PSD-95 immunofluorescence and microglial synaptic engulfment analysis
findings.quote: Immunofluorescent staining of PSD-95 revealed increased PSD-95 puncta in TAFE4 mice after knocking down astrocytic APOE4 (Figure 8A and 8B)
findings.summary: (astrocytic APOE4 removed) -> (less tau-induced synaptic loss and microglial synaptic phagocytosis)

findings.desc: Human iPSC-derived neurons expressing ApoE4/4 had significantly higher levels of tau phosphorylation than ApoE3/3 neurons by western blot with four p-tau antibodies, and a higher percentage of p-tau-positive neurons with p-tau mislocalized to the soma and dendrites; the increase was unrelated to their increased amyloid-beta production.
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived neurons from APOE3/3 and APOE4/4 donors, including isogenic gene-edited and APOE-deficient lines; p-tau western blot and immunostaining
findings.quote: Western blot analysis with p-tau-specific antibodies (AT8, AT180, PHF1, and AT270) revealed significantly higher p-tau levels in apoE4/4 neurons than apoE3/3 neurons
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (higher tau phosphorylation in human neurons)

findings.desc: Treating ApoE4/4 human iPSC-derived neurons with the small-molecule ApoE4 structure corrector PH002 reduced p-tau levels in a dose-dependent manner; PH002 had no significant effect on p-tau in ApoE-null neurons, indicating the effect depends on the presence of ApoE4. Class 2 because ApoE4 is perturbed indirectly, through a conformation-correcting drug.
findings.exp_system: Human APOE4/4 iPSC-derived neurons treated with the ApoE4 structure corrector PH002 (0-100 nM, 7 days), with APOE-deficient neurons as control; p-tau western blot
findings.quote: significantly decreased apoE4 fragment levels (Fig. 6a,b), increased GABAergic neuron numbers (Fig. 6c) and GAD67 levels (Fig. 6d,f), reduced p-tau levels (Fig. 6d,e), and decreased Aβ40 and Aβ42 production/secretion (Fig. 6g,h) in a dose-dependent manner (Fig. 6i–l)
findings.summary: (APOE4 structure corrected by PH002) -> (reduced p-tau levels)

findings.desc: In human iPSC-derived cerebral organoids at week 12, APOE4 genotype was associated with a significantly higher phosphorylated tau (AT8) to total tau ratio by western blot, in both healthy-subject-derived and Alzheimer's-disease-patient-derived organoids (APOE4 main effect p = 0.0037).
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived cerebral organoids from healthy and AD donors with APOE ε3/ε3 or ε4/ε4 genotypes; AT8 western blot of RIPA lysates normalized to total tau at week 12
findings.quote: western blotting with AT8 revealed that APOE4 and AD status were correlated with higher p-tau/tau ratio in the organoids (Fig. 4b–d)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (higher p-tau/tau ratio in cerebral organoids)

findings.desc: By ELISA of organoid RIPA lysates at week 12, APOE4 and AD status were independently associated with phosphorylated tau upregulation (APOE4 effect p < 0.0001), with higher p-tau levels in APOE4 organoids detectable as early as week 4.
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived cerebral organoids from healthy and AD donors with APOE ε3/ε3 or ε4/ε4 genotypes; p-tau ELISA of RIPA and formic acid fractions at week 12
findings.quote: When RIPA lysates (Fig. 4e) and FA fractions (Fig. 4f) were subjected to ELISA, APOE4, and AD status were independently associated with p-tau upregulation in the organoids at week 12.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (higher soluble p-tau in cerebral organoids)

findings.desc: Isogenic conversion of APOE4 to APOE3 in an AD patient's iPSC line reduced p-tau levels and p-tau/tau ratios in the derived cerebral organoids (AT8 western blot p = 0.0152), confirmed by ELISA of RIPA and formic acid fractions.
findings.exp_system: Cerebral organoids from a sporadic AD patient's APOE ε4/ε4 iPSC line and its isogenic APOE ε3/ε3 converted line; p-tau western blot and ELISA at week 12
findings.quote: Immunostaining (Fig. 7i) and western blotting (Fig. 7j) showed that APOE4 conversion to APOE3 reduced p-tau levels and p-tau/tau ratios in both RIPA (Fig. 7k) and FA fractions (Fig. 7l) in Iso-E3/3 organoids compared with Par-E4/4 organoids, which were confirmed by ELISA.
findings.summary: (APOE4 -> APOE3 isogenic conversion) -> (reduced p-tau levels and p-tau/tau ratios)

findings.desc: Conditioned media from lipid-droplet-high APOE4/4 human iPSC-derived microglia induced high concentrations of phosphorylated tau (AT8) in human iPSC-derived neurons, whereas media from lipid-droplet-low microglia induced pTau concentrations similar to untreated neurons; the effect was APOE-dependent (absent with APOE-knockout microglia media). Class 2 because the neuronal tau effect is delivered indirectly, through secreted factors from the APOE-genotype microglial state.
findings.exp_system: Human iPSC-derived microglia (APOE4/4) FACS-sorted into lipid-droplet-high and -low fractions; conditioned media applied to human iPSC-derived neurons; AT8 (pTau) immunofluorescence quantification
findings.quote: Only the LD-high iMG-conditioned media induced high concentrations of pTau in the iPS cell-derived neurons, whereas the LD-low iMG-conditioned media induced similar concentrations of pTau in the iPS cell-derived neurons as the untreated condition (Fig. 4b).
findings.summary: (APOE4/4 lipid-droplet-high microglia secretions) -> (tau phosphorylation in neurons)

findings.desc: In human Alzheimer's disease brain tissue, the ACSL1-positive, lipid-droplet-associated microglial state was most abundant in patients with the APOE4/4 genotype, quantified as the percentage of IBA1-positive microglia positive for ACSL1 (n = 5 subjects per group). Class 3 because the readout is a microglial inflammatory state, a surrogate for the neuroinflammation limb of the hypothesis, rather than tau itself.
findings.exp_system: Human AD and control postmortem brain tissue grouped by APOE genotype; single-nucleus RNA sequencing and ACSL1/IBA1 immunohistochemistry
findings.quote: Through single-nucleus RNA sequencing of brain tissue in Alzheimer's disease, we have identified a microglial state defined by the expression of the lipid droplet-associated enzyme ACSL1 with ACSL1-positive microglia being most abundant in patients with Alzheimer's disease having the APOE4/4 genotype.
findings.summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE4/4 in AD brain) -> (more ACSL1-positive lipid-droplet microglia)

findings.desc: In transgenic mice expressing human apoE in neurons, phosphorylated tau accumulated in an age-dependent manner in NSE-apoE4 mouse brains and, to a much lesser extent, in NSE-apoE3 mice, but not in mice expressing apoE3 or apoE4 in astrocytes; intraneuronal p-tau inclusions in the hippocampus were prominent in 21-month-old NSE-apoE4 mice but barely detectable in NSE-apoE3 mice. Abstract-only extraction: the PMC record carries the abstract only, so full-text statistics could not be checked.
findings.exp_system: Transgenic mice expressing human apoE3 or apoE4 in neurons (NSE-apoE) or astrocytes (GFAP-apoE); brain Western blotting and p-tau immunostaining
findings.quote: Phosphorylated tau (p-tau) also accumulated in an age-dependent manner in NSE-apoE4 mice and, to a much lesser extent, in NSE-apoE3 mice but not in GFAP-apoE3 or GFAP-apoE4 mice.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4 in neurons) -> (age-dependent accumulation of phosphorylated tau and intraneuronal p-tau inclusions)

findings.desc: C-terminal-truncated apoE fragments, the proposed neurotoxic mediator, accumulated age-dependently in the brains of neuron-specific NSE-apoE4 mice and, to a significantly lesser extent, NSE-apoE3 mice, with no fragments detected in astrocyte-specific GFAP-apoE mice; excitotoxic kainic acid challenge increased fragmentation in NSE-apoE4 but not NSE-apoE3 mice. Class 3 because fragment accumulation is an upstream surrogate readout, not tau itself. Abstract-only extraction.
findings.exp_system: Transgenic mice expressing human apoE3 or apoE4 in neurons (NSE-apoE) or astrocytes (GFAP-apoE); brain tissue Western blotting for apoE fragments
findings.quote: The C-terminal-truncated fragments of apoE accumulated, in an age-dependent manner, in the brains of NSE-apoE4 and, to a significantly lesser extent, NSE-apoE3 mice; however, no fragments were detected in GFAP-apoE3 or GFAP-apoE4 mice.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4 in neurons) -> (more C-terminal-truncated apoE fragments in brain)

findings.desc: Transgenic mice overexpressing human ApoE4 in neurons developed hyperphosphorylation of the microtubule-associated protein tau; in three independent transgenic lines from two different promoter constructs, increased tau phosphorylation was correlated with ApoE4 expression levels, and hyperphosphorylation increased with age, with hippocampal astrogliosis and ubiquitin-positive inclusions. Abstract-only extraction: the PMC record carries the abstract only, so full-text statistics could not be checked.
findings.exp_system: Transgenic mice overexpressing human ApoE4 in neurons under four distinct promoter constructs (three independent lines analysed for tau); brain tau phosphorylation analysis
findings.quote: Overexpression of human ApoE4 in neurons resulted in hyperphosphorylation of the microtubule-associated protein tau.
findings.summary: (neuronal human ApoE4 overexpression) -> (hyperphosphorylation of tau, correlated with ApoE4 expression level)

findings.desc: P301S tau mice expressing human APOE4 (TE4) reared germ-free showed a marked decrease in hippocampal tau phosphorylation (AT8 staining) at 40 weeks of age compared with conventionally raised TE4 mice; no difference was seen at 12 weeks. Class 2 because the perturbation (microbiota removal) acts on the APOE4-neuroinflammation pathway indirectly rather than on APOE4 itself.
findings.exp_system: P301S human tau transgenic mice with human APOE4 knock-in (TE4) reared germ-free in gnotobiotic isolators vs conventionally raised; hippocampal AT8 immunostaining at 40 weeks
findings.quote: Staining brain sections with a phospho-Tau antibody (AT8) revealed a marked decrease in tau phosphorylation in 40-week-old GF compared to 40-week-old Conv-R mice (Fig. 1C, E).
findings.summary: (germ-free rearing of APOE4 P301S tau mice) -> (markedly decreased hippocampal tau phosphorylation at 40 weeks)

findings.desc: Short-term antibiotic-cocktail perturbation of the gut microbiota in early life reduced phosphorylated tau levels in the detergent-soluble (RIPA) fraction and both p-Tau and human tau levels in the insoluble (formic acid) fraction of male cortical tissue at 40 weeks, across the APOE3, APOE4 and APOE-knockout genotype groups.
findings.exp_system: P301S tau transgenic mice expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 or lacking APOE, treated with an antibiotic cocktail by gavage on postnatal days 16-22 and assessed at 40 weeks; cortical tau biochemical fractionation
findings.quote: ABX-treatment reduced p-tau levels in the detergent soluble fraction (RIPA) and both p-Tau and human tau levels in the insoluble fraction (FA) across the three APOE genotype groups (Fig. S6)
findings.summary: (antibiotic microbiota depletion) -> (reduced soluble and insoluble p-tau across APOE genotypes)

findings.desc: The protection from microbiota perturbation was ApoE isoform-dependent: antibiotic-treated APOE3 tau mice (TE3-ABX), but not APOE4 tau mice (TE4-ABX), showed significant hippocampal preservation relative to water-treated controls, and vehicle-treated TE3 and TE4 mice both showed significant hippocampal atrophy compared with APOE-knockout mice.
findings.exp_system: P301S tau transgenic mice expressing human APOE3, APOE4 or no APOE, treated with an antibiotic cocktail on postnatal days 16-22; hippocampal volumetry at 40 weeks
findings.quote: However, TE3-ABX, but not TE4-ABX mice, showed significant hippocampal preservation relative to controls.
findings.summary: (antibiotic microbiota depletion) -> (hippocampal preservation in APOE3 but not APOE4 tau mice)

findings.desc: In primary neurons from homozygous NSE-ApoE4 transgenic mice, lentiviral shRNA knockdown of B2M (required for functional MHC-I expression) significantly reduced MHC-I expression and significantly reduced p-Tau mislocalization in both the soma and the dendrites, without altering apoE expression. Class 2 because the perturbation targets MHC-I, a downstream mediator of neuronal ApoE4, rather than APOE4 itself.
findings.exp_system: Primary neurons from homozygous NSE-apoE4 transgenic mice (mouse Apoe-knockout background) treated with lentiviral B2M shRNA vs scrambled shRNA; p-Tau immunocytochemistry
findings.quote: Importantly, B2M-knockdown also significantly reduced p-Tau mislocalization both in the soma (Fig 7e, g) and in the dendrites (Fig 7f, g) of NSE-E4 +/+ primary neurons.
findings.summary: (MHC-I reduction via B2M knockdown in ApoE4 neurons) -> (reduced p-Tau mislocalization)

findings.desc: In vivo, functional reduction of MHC-I by B2M knockout ameliorated AAV2-delivered human P301S tau pathology in mouse hippocampus: the p-Tau to total human Tau ratio was significantly reduced in CA1 (p = 0.001) and dentate gyrus (p = 0.008) of B2M-KO mice compared with wild-type mice 6 weeks after injection, despite similar human tau expression.
findings.exp_system: Wild-type and B2M-knockout mice injected intrahippocampally with AAV2 expressing human pathological Tau-P301S; p-Tau (PHF1) and total human tau (HT7) immunostaining at 6 weeks
findings.quote: Functional reduction of MHC-I ameliorated the induced Tau pathology, as determined with the ratio of p-Tau to total human Tau, in both CA1 and DG of the hippocampus (Fig. 8).
findings.summary: (MHC-I reduction via B2M knockout) -> (reduced p-Tau/total Tau ratio in hippocampus)

findings.desc: Neuronal ApoE expression level causally drives neuronal MHC-I expression: primary neurons from homozygous NSE-E4 mice had a significantly higher level of MHC-I protein than neurons from heterozygous NSE-E4 mice, and neuronal ApoE elimination reduced MHC-I at RNA and protein levels. Class 3 because MHC-I is a mediator readout (surrogate B'), not tau itself.
findings.exp_system: Primary neurons from homozygous vs heterozygous NSE-apoE4 transgenic mice on a mouse Apoe-knockout background; MHC-I western blot
findings.quote: western blot analysis also revealed a significantly higher level of MHC-I in NSE-E4 +/+ than in NSE-E4 +/− primary neurons (Fig. 6j)
findings.summary: (higher neuronal ApoE4 dose) -> (higher neuronal MHC-I expression)

findings.desc: Carboxyl-terminal-truncated apoE, which occurs in Alzheimer's disease brains, induced intracellular neurofibrillary-tangle-like inclusions composed of phosphorylated tau, phosphorylated neurofilaments and truncated apoE in cultured neurons; truncated apoE4, especially apoE4(Δ272-299), induced inclusions in up to 75% of transfected neuronal cells but not in nonneuronal cells, and apoE4 was more susceptible to truncation than apoE3 and produced much greater inclusion formation. Class 2 because the perturbation is a truncated fragment of ApoE4 rather than full-length APOE4 itself. Abstract-only extraction: the PMC record carries the abstract only, so full-text statistics could not be checked.
findings.exp_system: Cultured neuronal cells transfected with carboxyl-terminal-truncated apoE3 or apoE4 constructs; immunostaining for phosphorylated tau inclusions
findings.quote: Truncated apoE4, especially apoE4(Δ272–299), induced inclusions in up to 75% of transfected neuronal cells, but not in transfected nonneuronal cells.
findings.summary: (truncated apoE4(Δ272-299) expression) -> (NFT-like inclusions containing phosphorylated tau in up to 75% of neurons)

findings.desc: Transgenic mice expressing the carboxyl-terminal-truncated product apoE4(Δ272-299) in the brain displayed Alzheimer's-disease-like neurodegenerative alterations in cortex and hippocampus, including abnormally phosphorylated tau and Gallyas silver-positive neurons containing cytosolic straight filaments of 15-20 nm resembling preneurofibrillary tangles; the fragment is generated by a protease that cleaves apoE4 more efficiently than apoE3. Class 2 because the perturbation is a truncated fragment of ApoE4 rather than full-length APOE4 itself. Abstract-only extraction: the PMC record carries the abstract only, so full-text statistics could not be checked.
findings.exp_system: Transgenic mice expressing carboxyl-terminal-truncated apoE4(Δ272-299) at high or low levels in brain; cortical and hippocampal histology and p-tau assessment
findings.quote: The cortex and hippocampus of these mice displayed AD-like neurodegenerative alterations, including abnormally phosphorylated tau (p-tau) and Gallyas silver-positive neurons that contained cytosolic straight filaments with diameters of 15–20 nm, resembling preneurofibrillary tangles.
findings.summary: (truncated apoE4(Δ272-299) expression in brain) -> (abnormally phosphorylated tau and preneurofibrillary-tangle-like neurons)
